sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Verbatim match on level, day, and recency claim.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: Attributed to J.P. Morgan Rates Strategy in the source; view and mechanism match.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: Trade, levels, and JPM attribution match exactly.

sentences.span: Citi's rates desk, by contrast, sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold on a closing basis.
sentences.why: Attribution, view, and level match exactly.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener
sentences.why: Day, metric, and consensus figure match; 'test for the steepener' is a fair compression of the conditional validate/not-reverse framing, not a distortion of direction or status.
